distribution_model: single Windows one-file package with bundled Basic Pitch ONNX CPU inference
required_review_items: Review the exact transitive dependency inventory generated by scripts/audit_transcription_licenses.py.
Verify redistribution terms and required notices for the Basic Pitch ONNX model.
Verify notices for native libraries bundled by ONNX Runtime, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, SoundFile, libsoxr, Numba, and llvmlite.
Confirm that all required license and notice texts are shipped with the release artifact.
Record the approved inventory digest, reviewer, and UTC review time before setting public_release_cleared to true.
note: The v1.0.0 public build is cleared only for this deterministic schema-2 inventory. The published v0.3.0 schema-1 digest remains historical release evidence; any future inventory change fails closed and requires a new maintainer review.
